{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///dfs9/ucightf-lab/projects/ChanA/251216_ChanA_smallRNA/src/generate_report.py)",

  "isConfirmed": {

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nGenerate a project report for small RNA sequencing data\nwith metadata extracted from FASTQ files.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport glob\nimport gzip\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom collections import defaultdict\nfrom reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter, A4\nfrom reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle\nfrom reportlab.lib.units import inch\nfrom reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Table, TableStyle, Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak, Image\nfrom reportlab.lib import colors\nfrom reportlab.lib.enums import TA_CENTER, TA_LEFT, TA_RIGHT\n\n\nclass FASTQMetadataExtractor:\n    \"\"\"Extract metadata from FASTQ files\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, fastq_dir):\n        self.fastq_dir = fastq_dir\n        self.samples = {}\n        self.parse_samples()\n    \n    def parse_samples(self):\n        \"\"\"Parse sample names and file sizes from FASTQ directory\"\"\"\n        r1_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(self.fastq_dir, \"*-R1.fastq.gz\")))\n        r2_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(self.fastq_dir, \"*-R2.fastq.gz\")))\n        \n        for r1_file in r1_files:\n            basename = os.path.basename(r1_file).replace(\"-R1.fastq.gz\", \"\")\n            r2_file = os.path.join(self.fastq_dir, basename + \"-R2.fastq.gz\")\n            \n            r1_size = os.path.getsize(r1_file) / (1024**3)  # Convert to GB\n            r2_size = os.path.getsize(r2_file) / (1024**3) if os.path.exists(r2_file) else 0\n            \n            # Count reads in R1 file (sample first few lines)\n            read_count = self._count_reads_sample(r1_file)\n            \n            self.samples[basename] = {\n                'r1_path': r1_file,\n                'r2_path': r2_file if os.path.exists(r2_file) else None,\n                'r1_size_gb': r1_size,\n                'r2_size_gb': r2_size,\n                'read_count': read_count,\n                'total_size_gb': r1_size + r2_size\n            }\n    \n    def _count_reads_sample(self, fastq_file, sample_lines=1000):\n        \"\"\"Estimate read count by sampling lines from gzip FASTQ file\"\"\"\n        try:\n            with gzip.open(fastq_file, 'rt') as f:\n                count = 0\n                for _ in range(sample_lines):\n                    line = f.readline()\n                    if not line:\n                        break\n                    if line.startswith('@') and not line.startswith('@+'):\n                        count += 1\n            \n            # Estimate total from sample\n            total_size = os.path.getsize(fastq_file)\n            file_handle = gzip.open(fastq_file, 'rb')\n            first_1000_bytes = file_handle.read(1000)\n            file_handle.close()\n            \n            # Rough estimation: 4 lines per read\n            estimated_reads = (total_size / len(first_1000_bytes)) * (count / 4) * 1000\n            return int(estimated_reads)\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Warning: Could not count reads in {fastq_file}: {e}\")\n            return 0\n    \n    def get_summary(self):\n        \"\"\"Get summary statistics\"\"\"\n        total_samples = len(self.samples)\n        total_size = sum(s['total_size_gb'] for s in self.samples.values())\n        avg_size = total_size / total_samples if total_samples &gt; 0 else 0\n        \n        return {\n            'total_samples': total_samples,\n            'total_size_gb': total_size,\n            'avg_size_gb': avg_size,\n            'generation_date': datetime.now().strftime(\"%B %d, %Y\")\n        }\n\n\nclass ReportGenerator:\n    \"\"\"Generate PDF report\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, output_path, author, clc_version, library_kit, fastq_dir):\n        self.output_path = output_path\n        self.author = author\n        self.clc_version = clc_version\n        self.library_kit = library_kit\n        self.extractor = FASTQMetadataExtractor(fastq_dir)\n        self.summary = self.extractor.get_summary()\n    \n    def generate(self):\n        \"\"\"Generate the PDF report\"\"\"\n        doc = SimpleDocTemplate(\n            self.output_path,\n            pagesize=letter,\n            rightMargin=0.75*inch,\n            leftMargin=0.75*inch,\n            topMargin=0.75*inch,\n            bottomMargin=0.75*inch,\n        )\n        \n        elements = []\n        styles = getSampleStyleSheet()\n        \n        # Custom styles\n        title_style = ParagraphStyle(\n            'CustomTitle',\n            parent=styles['Heading1'],\n            fontSize=24,\n            textColor=colors.HexColor('#1f4788'),\n            spaceAfter=12,\n            alignment=TA_CENTER,\n            fontName='Helvetica-Bold'\n        )\n        \n        heading_style = ParagraphStyle(\n            'CustomHeading',\n            parent=styles['Heading2'],\n            fontSize=14,\n            textColor=colors.HexColor('#1f4788'),\n            spaceAfter=12,\n            spaceBefore=12,\n            fontName='Helvetica-Bold'\n        )\n        \n        # Title\n        elements.append(Paragraph(\"Small RNA Sequencing Project Report\", title_style))\n        elements.append(Spacer(1, 0.2*inch))\n        \n        # Project Information\n        elements.append(Paragraph(\"Project Information\", heading_style))\n        project_info = [\n            ['Generation Date:', self.summary['generation_date']],\n            ['Author:', self.author],\n            ['CLC Genomics Workbench Version:', self.clc_version],\n            ['Library Kit:', self.library_kit],\n        ]\n        \n        info_table = Table(project_info, colWidths=[2*inch, 4*inch])\n        info_table.setStyle(TableStyle([\n            ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (0, -1), colors.HexColor('#E8EEF7')),\n            ('TEXTCOLOR', (0, 0), (-1, -1), colors.black),\n            ('ALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'LEFT'),\n            ('FONTNAME', (0, 0), (0, -1), 'Helvetica-Bold'),\n            ('FONTSIZE', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 10),\n            ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 8),\n            ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 8),\n            ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 1, colors.grey),\n        ]))\n        elements.append(info_table)\n        elements.append(Spacer(1, 0.3*inch))\n        \n        # Summary Statistics\n        elements.append(Paragraph(\"Summary Statistics\", heading_style))\n        summary_data = [\n            ['Metric', 'Value'],\n            ['Total Samples', str(self.summary['total_samples'])],\n            ['Total Data Size', f\"{self.summary['total_size_gb']:.2f} GB\"],\n            ['Average Size per Sample', f\"{self.summary['avg_size_gb']:.2f} GB\"],\n        ]\n        \n        summary_table = Table(summary_data, colWidths=[2.5*inch, 2.5*inch])\n        summary_table.setStyle(TableStyle([\n            ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (-1, 0), colors.HexColor('#1f4788')),\n            ('TEXTCOLOR', (0, 0), (-1, 0), colors.whitesmoke),\n            ('ALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'CENTER'),\n            ('FONTNAME', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 'Helvetica-Bold'),\n            ('FONTSIZE', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 10),\n            ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 8),\n            ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 8),\n            ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 1, colors.grey),\n            ('ROWBACKGROUNDS', (0, 1), (-1, -1), [colors.white, colors.HexColor('#F0F0F0')]),\n        ]))\n        elements.append(summary_table)\n        elements.append(Spacer(1, 0.3*inch))\n        \n        # Sample Details\n        elements.append(Paragraph(\"Sample Details\", heading_style))\n        \n        sample_data = [['Sample Name', 'R1 Size (GB)', 'R2 Size (GB)', 'Total Size (GB)', 'Est. Reads']]\n        \n        for sample_name in sorted(self.extractor.samples.keys()):\n            sample_info = self.extractor.samples[sample_name]\n            sample_data.append([\n                sample_name[:30] + '...' if len(sample_name) &gt; 30 else sample_name,\n                f\"{sample_info['r1_size_gb']:.2f}\",\n                f\"{sample_info['r2_size_gb']:.2f}\",\n                f\"{sample_info['total_size_gb']:.2f}\",\n                f\"{sample_info['read_count']:,.0f}\" if sample_info['read_count'] &gt; 0 else 'N/A',\n            ])\n        \n        samples_table = Table(sample_data, colWidths=[1.8*inch, 1*inch, 1*inch, 1.2*inch, 1.2*inch])\n        samples_table.setStyle(TableStyle([\n            ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (-1, 0), colors.HexColor('#1f4788')),\n            ('TEXTCOLOR', (0, 0), (-1, 0), colors.whitesmoke),\n            ('ALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'CENTER'),\n            ('ALIGN', (0, 0), (0, -1), 'LEFT'),\n            ('FONTNAME', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 'Helvetica-Bold'),\n            ('FONTSIZE', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 9),\n            ('FONTSIZE', (0, 1), (-1, -1), 8),\n            ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 6),\n            ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 6),\n            ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, colors.grey),\n            ('ROWBACKGROUNDS', (0, 1), (-1, -1), [colors.white, colors.HexColor('#F5F5F5')]),\n        ]))\n        elements.append(samples_table)\n        \n        # Build PDF\n        doc.build(elements)\n        print(f\"Report generated successfully: {self.output_path}\")\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function\"\"\"\n    import argparse\n    \n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(\n        description='Generate a small RNA sequencing project report'\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\n        '--fastq-dir',\n        default='data/FASTQ',\n        help='Path to FASTQ directory (default: data/FASTQ)'\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\n        '--output',\n        default='SmallRNA_Project_Report.pdf',\n        help='Output PDF path (default: SmallRNA_Project_Report.pdf)'\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\n        '--author',\n        default='Kevin Stachelek',\n        help='Report author name'\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\n        '--clc-version',\n        default='v25',\n        help='CLC Genomics Workbench version'\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\n        '--library-kit',\n        default='Revvity NEXTflex Small RNA v4',\n        help='Library kit used for sequencing'\n    )\n    \n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    \n    # Validate FASTQ directory\n    if not os.path.isdir(args.fastq_dir):\n        print(f\"Error: FASTQ directory not found: {args.fastq_dir}\")\n        return 1\n    \n    # Generate report\n    generator = ReportGenerator(\n        output_path=args.output,\n        author=args.author,\n        clc_version=args.clc_version,\n        library_kit=args.library_kit,\n        fastq_dir=args.fastq_dir\n    )\n    \n    generator.generate()\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    exit(main())\n",

_**User (2026-01-17 00:25Z)**_

add these sections to the report General Pipeline 
FastQC v 0.11.91 
FastQC was run on all Fastq files to determine the sequencing data quality and presence of adapters. The 
94 html reports were exported and zipped. 
Cutadapt v2.102 
Cutadapt was then used to trim the reads according to Revvity’s NEXTflex small RNA v3 trimming 
guidelines. Due to small size of small RNA insert, only Read1 was used for analysis. The Nextera 
transposase sequence was first trimmed from Read1. Then the 3’ adapter sequence 
(TGGAATTCTCGGGTGCCAAGG) was trimmed, while removing reads that are less than 15bp. Finally, 4 
bases were trimmed from either end of the adapter-trimmed reads. 
CLC Genomics Workbench v22.03 
The trimmed Pair-end reads were imported into Qiagen CLC Genomics Workbench for further 
processing. CLC “Trim Reads“ was first used to remove any reads whose insert was greater than 55bp. 
Then “Quantify miRNA v1.3” was used to quantify and count the miRNA using miRBase-Release_v22 
prioritizing Homo Sapiens with the following parameters: allow length-based isomiRs, 2 base additional 
up/downstream, 2 base missing up/downstream, maximum mismatch = 2, minimum sequence length = 
15, maximum sequence length = 55, and minimum supporting count = 1. In addition, “Combined miRNA 
Report v1.0“ was used to consolidate all 94 individual miRNA quantification reports into one report. The 
report was exported as an excel file and was slightly edited to convert from analysis ids to sample names. 
The individual miRNA quantification reports and results were exported and zipped in pdf and Excel 
formats. 
References 1 Andrews S. (2010). FastQC: a quality control tool for high throughput sequence data. Available online 
at: http://www.bioinformatics.babraham.ac.uk/projects/fastqc 
2 Martin, Marcel. "Cutadapt removes adapter sequences from high-throughput sequencing reads." 
EMBnet.journal [Online], 17.1 (2011): pp. 10-12. Web. 22 Jul. 2024 
3 QIAGEN CLC Main Workbench 22.0. 
https://resources.qiagenbioinformatics.com/manuals/clcgenomicsworkbench/2302/index.php?manual=I
ntroduction_CLC_Genomics_Workbench.html
